main_text.p: differre : unde infert non ita antiquam esse N. T. Syriaci verfionem ut vulgo putatur, fed plus temporis poft Chriftum interfuiffe, ante quam facta effet ifta verfio, quod mutationem illam in linguam Syriacam intulit ; fed notandum, Syriacae linguae varias fuiffe dialectos, ut idem Breerwoodus, Buxtorfius & alii obfervant : dialectus enim Galilaea, ab Hierofolymitana differebat adeo, ut ex Petri fermone colligerent ipfum effe Galilaeum Marc. 14. 70. magis enim rudis & agreftis erat fermo Galilaeus, ut exiftimat Buxtorf in Lexic. Talm.Rabb. voce [?].

35. Præcipuæ verò ejus Dialecti erant. 1. Babylonica omnium puriffima, in qua fcripta funt capitula quædam Danielis & Efræ, & poftea licet ftylo non ita puro Onkelofi & Jonathæ Paraphrafes, & Talmud Babyloni-cum. 2. Hierofolymitana, quæ à genuina Chaldaica plus diftabat per mixturam verborum peregrinorum, fcil. Arabicorum, Græcorum & Latinorum quam longo tempore contraxit : & in hac fcripta funt Talmud & Targum Hierofolymitanum, Targum in Hagiographa, & Jonathanis in Legem, liber Zohar, & quædam Medrashim feu expofitiones allegoricæ. 3. Antiochena Comagena & Maronitica, quæ Antiochena dicebatur, quia circa Antiochenum tractum in ufu fuit, & in Ecclefia Antiochena & per totum Patriarchatum in Sacris ufurpata ; Comagena verò à Comagene ultimâ Syriæ regione, & Maronitica, à Ma-ronitis

page.notes: The Hebrew word in the citation "Talm.Rabb. voce" is printed in Hebrew letters and is not legible enough to copy; left as [?]. The right edge carries cut-off letters of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The signature reads "B.5" on the scan and is given as "B 5". The catchword "ronitis" is the first word of the next page. Some letters at the line ends are partly cut off in the scan, so the words "Galilaeus" and "Chaldaica" were read from context and may contain small errors. The Latin in "Hierofolymitana, quæ à genuina" and "Medrashim" is copied as printed.
